content.text: The redline validates cleanly. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
input.rationale: Section 6.1 (p0037) is a non-compete/field-of-use restriction binding the Company, our client, and it fails the fallback on three material terms. Scope is open-ended rather than a named competing product: it reaches "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and, "without limitation", the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled "and companies similar to" them — the undefined scope the playbook treats as walk-away territory. Duration is uncapped: under Section 4.1 (p0024) the term auto-renews for successive one-year periods, so "during the term" can run indefinitely rather than 12 months. There is no carve-out for our internal development or for acquisitions; the only exception (Section 6.2) is a narrow closeout-merchandise site, and the Section 9(b) Globix carve-out is transitional only. The during-the-term-only element is already satisfied, as Section 10.7 (p0068) limits survival to Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10, leaving no post-term tail on 6.1. Because HDI funds all Site development and hosting and is paid solely from Net Sales on the Site, its relationship plausibly needs protection, so we target the fallback rather than deleting the covenant: one edit narrows the restriction to the named Deerskin Products, caps it at twelve months within the term, and carves out our internal development and acquisitions, leaving HDI's "Deerskin" brand exclusivity for the Site intact. Section 6.3's two-year restriction binds HDI and benefits us, so it is not flagged.

mappings.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
The restriction applies during the term only.
mappings.quote: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site

mappings.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
The restriction permits Customer's internal development.

proposal.summary: Narrow the Section 6.1 restriction on the Company to Deerskin Products only, cap it at twelve months during the term, and carve out our internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an open-ended restriction on the businesses we operate, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products, deleted the "substantially similar products/companies" language, capped the restriction at twelve (12) months within the term, and carved out our internal development and acquisitions. HDI's exclusive right to use the "Deerskin" brand for the Site is left untouched.

ops.newText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement and in no event for more than twelve (12) months, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products (which restriction shall not apply to the Company's internal development or any acquisition by or of the Company)
